question: Do the four actual clock-carrier fields provide a complete source-defined probe menu for arbitrary neutral quadratic response, including off-diagonal alignment?
scope: Original eight-current vacuum Heisenberg sector and same-coordinate C/J/P5; mixed two-point responses to iterated weight-two OPE coefficients. Not a physical detector, charged-sector or complete-source theorem.
summary_de: Vier tatsächliche Clockbilder von P5 erzeugen durch die Doppelpol-OPE alle36 reellen symmetrischen quadratischen Stromfelder. Eine explizite rationale Inverse rekonstruiert ihre vollständige8x8-Matrix, einschließlich Offdiagonalen; bei vorgegebener Spur bleiben35 Richtungen. Damit ist die algebraische Lücke der bisherigen Dreisektortomographie geschlossen. Physischer Probezugriff, Zustandstransfer und gemeinsame Quellenauswahl bleiben zusätzliche Aufgaben.
summary_en: Four actual clock images of P5 generate all36 real symmetric quadratic current fields through the double-pole OPE. An explicit rational inverse reconstructs the full8x8 matrix including off-diagonal alignment; prescribed trace leaves35 directions. This closes the earlier three-sector algebraic tomography gap, not physical access, state transfer or common-source selection.
assumptions: Original native free-current vacuum contraction, normal ordering and real symmetric quadratic fields.
Same E8 current-index basis, actual supplied C/J and native marked P5.
Access to mixed vacuum responses and iterated weight-two double-pole OPE coefficients; four scalar outputs alone are insufficient.
positive_results: Four generator fields alone span Sym8 through Jordan words of degree at most4; basis degree counts4,6,16,10.
Explicit rational36x36 inverse reconstructs every real symmetric coefficient matrix; all36 canonical input directions checked.
Same240E8 roots and originalP5 certify common coordinate basis; no dimension-only dictionary.
Traceless response space has dimension35. Original R still has Tr(P5R)=0.
kills: Claim that identical self-correlators identify marked carrier alignment; earlier isospectral counterexample remains binding.
leaves_open: Physical source selection from P1/P2, detector access to the generated mixed response family, and state transfer.
Charged spin/defect fields, multitime instruments, unnormalized geometry and full physical completion.
not_claimed: No physical5/4 susceptibility derivation, no T1-T8 closure or ledger promotion.
No new general Wick theorem; source-specific composition of existing results.
